acceptedDeferral.condition: Roll out the corrected namespace-controller image and pass the live verifier.

K8S-INPUT-001.rationale: Both paths reject a requested deployment when the required manifest is absent.

K8S-INPUT-002.rationale: The replacement consumes one explicit typed artifact.

K8S-INPUT-003.rationale: The replacement verifies the artifact type, size, digest, and local URL.

K8S-INPUT-004.rationale: Both paths require one service name and one service port.

K8S-IMAGE-001.rationale: Both paths require the selected workload image in the applied manifest.

K8S-IMAGE-002.rationale: The replacement accepts only an immutable image from an allowed local repository.

K8S-IMAGE-003.rationale: The replacement compares the declared digest with the image-reference digest.

K8S-IMAGE-004.rationale: Deployment no longer builds or promotes an image.

K8S-MANIFEST-001.rationale: Both paths accept multi-document Kubernetes YAML.

K8S-MANIFEST-002.rationale: The replacement applies the exact checked bytes without rewriting them.

K8S-MANIFEST-003.rationale: The replacement rejects an explicit namespace before deployment.

K8S-MANIFEST-005.rationale: Every replacement workload image must contain a SHA-256 digest.

K8S-MANIFEST-006.rationale: At least one workload must use the selected application image.

K8S-MANIFEST-007.rationale: Operator limits bound the resource count and manifest bytes.

K8S-LEASE-001.rationale: Both paths request an isolated BusterNamespaceLease.

K8S-LEASE-002.rationale: Both paths verify create, get, and delete lease permissions.

K8S-LEASE-003.rationale: Both paths use a server-side dry-run before lease creation.

K8S-LEASE-004.rationale: The replacement derives deterministic attempt-scoped names.

K8S-LEASE-005.rationale: Source proof is complete. Successful controller readiness proof awaits the accepted image rollout.

K8S-LEASE-006.rationale: Rejected, failed, and timed-out leases cannot return a fixture value.

K8S-READY-001.rationale: Exact apply is source-proved. Live completion awaits the accepted controller rollout.

K8S-READY-002.rationale: Pod discovery is source-proved. Live completion awaits the accepted controller rollout.

K8S-READY-003.rationale: Ready-condition enforcement is source-proved. Live completion awaits the accepted controller rollout.

K8S-READY-004.rationale: The replacement converts readiness timeout into execution failure.

K8S-OUTPUT-001.rationale: The fixture returns one schema-bound deployment value.

K8S-OUTPUT-002.rationale: The value includes the namespace and internal service endpoint.

K8S-OUTPUT-003.rationale: The value includes creation, expiry, and release data.

K8S-OUTPUT-004.rationale: The value binds the checked manifest digest and immutable image.

K8S-SECRET-001.rationale: The lease contract preserves approved secret copying. Live completion awaits the accepted controller rollout.

K8S-SECRET-002.rationale: The fixture returns secret references without reading values.

K8S-DEFECT-001.rationale: Decoded secret values cannot enter fixture logs or outputs.

K8S-CLEANUP-001.rationale: Lease deletion is source-proved. Live completion awaits the accepted controller rollout.

K8S-CLEANUP-002.rationale: Cleanup is a mandatory provider lifecycle operation.

K8S-CLEANUP-003.rationale: Deterministic identity permits cleanup after a provider restart.

K8S-CLEANUP-004.rationale: The controller contract enforces bounded retained-fixture expiry.

K8S-CLEANUP-005.rationale: The result supplies an explicit early-release action.

K8S-SCOPE-001.rationale: The fixture prepares resources and does not decide product quality.

K8S-SCOPE-002.rationale: The fixture creates no public exposure.

K8S-SCOPE-003.rationale: Application HTTP assertions remain a separate test.

K8S-SCOPE-004.rationale: Rendering and static validation remain separate actions.

K8S-SECURITY-001.rationale: The provider receives only kubernetes.fixture authority.

K8S-SECURITY-002.rationale: Canonical manifest paths must remain inside the run-owned root.

K8S-SECURITY-003.rationale: The capability restricts namespace prefixes and registry repositories.

K8S-RUNTIME-001.rationale: Cancellation and timeout cannot produce a passing result.

K8S-RUNTIME-002.rationale: The provider is not retry-safe and defaults to zero retries.

K8S-AUTHORITY-001.rationale: The replacement remained non-authoritative through parity.

K8S-AUTHORITY-002.rationale: The legacy suite remained sole authority until the cutover commit.
